name: walk_edge
sql:
CREATE TABLE walk_edge(origin TEXT,destination TEXT,air_meters REAL,
                distance_meters REAL,seconds REAL,geometry TEXT,source TEXT,checked_at TEXT,status TEXT,
                PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination))

name: walk_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE walk_meta(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),value TEXT)

name: stop_snap
sql: CREATE TABLE stop_snap(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,distance_meters REAL,lat REAL,lon REAL,hint TEXT)
